items.summary: The visual upgrade is nice, but Complete Edition is a little lacking in QoL.
items.body: I blink and I've somehow spent another 30 hours in Shogun 2. Undoubtedly my favorite of the older Total War games—and I don't say that lightly as someone who also has big hour counts in Rome and Medieval 2—there's just something so straightforward about the second Shogun; an elegant simplicity complimented by a period where the Creative Assembly was clearly having fun experimenting with all sorts of ideas. It's no wonder it chose to remaster the game despite the fact it's arguably the best aged Total War there is. I'd happily go back and play Shogun 2 over Rome 2, or even Attila, which I think speaks to how well it holds up. It's definitely nice to play Shogun 2 with improved visuals (if you like the new style), modern unit controls, and full Japanese voice acting, but I think Creative Assembly missed the mark in terms of the remaster's other additions. To give it a fair shot, I started with one of the newly introduced island-bound minor factions, Honma. I always love conquering this island in campaigns because they have a gold mine, plus starting on an island in the north adds loads of possibilities. items.summary: قمة مرتقبة
items.body: قمة مرتقبة   يتصدر باريس سان جيرمان دوري أبطال أوروبا بعد فوزه الساحق 6-1 على سلوفان براتيسلافا، لكنه سيواجه خصماً أشدّ صعوبة يوم الأربعاء المقبل.  ويسافر حامل اللقب الأوروبي إلى إنجلترا لمواجهة مانشستر سيتي، في قمة أوروبية مرتقبة.  وسيدير المباراة حكم ألماني، حيث أعلن الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم (يويفا) اختيار سفين يابلونسكي لقيادة هذه المباراة ضمن الجولة الثانية من دوري الأبطال، وسيساعده مواطناه إدوارد بيتينجر وكريستيان ديتز. ستكون هذه المرة الأولى التي يدير فيها يابلونسكي مباراةً لفريق باريس سان جيرمان في دوري أبطال أوروبا. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة مع ذلك، سبق له إدارة مباراة لمانشستر سيتي في البطولة الأوروبية الأهم، وذلك في الموسم الماضي، خلال خسارته خارج أرضهم أمام بودو/جليمت (1-3) في دور المجموعات.  أخيرًا، شاهد المشجعون الفرنسيون يابلونسكي في مباراة هذا الموسم، حيث أدار مباراة الذهاب من الملحق المؤهل لدوري أبطال أوروبا بين فنربخشة وأولمبيك ليون (1-1).

items.body: "يجب أن نشيد بهم دون أي تردد أو شك" حذر جاري نيفيل، أسطورة مانشستر يونايتد، من أن استمرار إدانة مانشستر سيتي "سيئ للغاية بالنسبة للدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز" بعد فوزهم المذهل على ليفربول. واعترف مدافع مانشستر يونايتد السابق بأنه يجد صعوبة في الإشادة بأداء السيتي دون التفكير في حالة عدم اليقين التي تحيط بمستقبل النادي. وحقق فريق إنزو ماريسكا فوزاً مهما على ليفربول بنتيجة 3-0 في ملعب أنفيلد ليحافظ على بدايته المثالية لموسم الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز. سجل كل من إيرلينج هالاند وجيريمي دوكو وريان شرقي أهدافاً بعد طرد ريان جرافنبيرش في الشوط الثاني. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة لكن فوز السيتي المثير للإعجاب جاء في ظل خلفية درامية، بعد أن أدين نادي الاتحاد بأكثر من 100 انتهاك للقواعد المالية للدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز خلال فترة تسعة مواسم. استأنف النادي القرار وينتظر النتيجة، مع احتمال فرض عقوبات شديدة على النادي. ويعتقد نيفيل أن حالة عدم اليقين هذه تلقي بظلالها الكبيرة على كرة القدم الإنجليزية. وفي حديثه على قناة " سكاي سبورتس "، قال: "إن الفوز في ملعب أنفيلد أمر صعب للغاية، ويجب أن نشيد بهم دون أي تردد أو شك". وتابع: "لكن هناك ذلك الشيء الذي يدور في ذهنك وهو أنهم قاموا بعمل رائع هنا اليوم، من الواضح أنهم سيطروا على المباراة في آخر 20 دقيقة منذ البطاقة الحمراء. لقد صمدوا…

items.summary: ماذا حدث؟
items.body: ماذا حدث؟ يستعد معتمد جمال، المدير الفني للفريق الأول لكرة القدم بنادي الزمالك المصري، للخضوع لجراحة عاجلة خلال الساعات المقبلة، بسبب آلام الظهر التي يعاني منها منذ فترة، وعقب خسارة فريقه أمام الأهلي في قمة الدوري المصري الممتاز. وكشف نجل المدير الفني، عن خضوع والده للجراحة، مطالبًا متابعيه بالدعاء له بالشفاء. وكتب عبر حسابه الرسمي على موقع "فيسبوك": "أرجو منكم الدعاء لوالدي، فهو يخضع لجراحة عاجلة للتخلص من آلام الظهر التي يعاني منها منذ مدة. أسأل الله أن يمنّ عليه بالشفاء العاجل وتمام الصحة والعافية، لا تنسوه من صالح دعائكم". وفي السياق ذاته، وجهت زوجة معتمد جمال رسالة مؤثرة عبر حسابها الرسمي، عبّرت خلالها عن قلقها على حالته الصحية، قائلة: "ربنا يطمنّا عليك.. فداك الدنيا يا حبيبي". وتأتي هذه التطورات بعد خسارة الزمالك أمام غريمه التقليدي الأهلي بهدفين دون رد، في المباراة التي جمعتهما مساء الأحد11 أكتوبر/تشرين الأول على استاد القاهرة الدولي، ضمن منافسات الجولة السادسة من الدوري المصري الممتاز، ليتلقى الفريق الأبيض هزيمته الأولى في المسابقة هذا الموسم. ويتحول تركيز الزمالك إلى الاستحقاق القاري المقبل، إذ يستعد لمواجهة الجيش الرواندي يوم الجمعة، ضمن ذهاب دور الـ32 من بطولة دوري أبطال إفريقيا، وسط ترقب لموقف معتمد جمال بعد خضوعه للجراحة.

items.summary: الأحمر حسم الديربي بهدفين

items.title: Steam Week in Review: The curious case of Wonder Boy in Monster Land's dubious PC debut
items.summary: All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending October 11.
items.body: Wonder Boy in Monster Land released in Japanese arcades in 1987 and for the Sega Master System the following year. Its success led to numerous ports, including to ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari ST. Oddly, it never received an official PC port, though that long absence appeared to have come to an end on September 28. Did fans rejoice? Not really. The Steam listing for Wonderboy in Monster Land raises one immediate red flag: note the rookie error of "Wonderboy" versus Wonder Boy. The developer and publisher is Retro Maniac, whose only other Steam game is Street Hoop, or Street Slam, an old Data East arcade game from 1994. To bring you up to speed: LAT Corp owns all IP and assets once belonging to Westone Bit Entertainment, the creators of the original Wonder Boy games. But at the same time Sega, confusingly, owns the Wonder Boy trademark. In other words: LAT Corp owns the games, Sega owns the name. Both parties would need to OK any Wonder Boy re-release bearing the Wonder Boy name. items.title: Star Wars Galactic Racer's devs tested its roguelite progression system by turning it into a board game
items.summary: "You can't know if you can feel the system until you can play the system."
items.body: Years ago, I read that Jake Solomon prototyped the Firaxis reboot of XCOM by making a simple board game version. Something rudimentary that could be played in the office on scrap paper to get ideas across and figure out where the fun would be, without having to commit. But it's surprising to hear the same idea being used for a game as different from XCOM's turn-based tactics as Star Wars Galactic Racer. As Fuse Games' creative director Kieran Crimmins told Eurogamer , "You can't know if you can feel the system until you can play the system." And so the early prototype of this high-speed arcade racing game was indeed a board game. "You know, modern engines are so capable that you can do a lot of it in-software," CEO Matt Webster said, "but there's still something [about that which is] not as fast as getting a written idea down. From a board game perspective, you sort of decouple yourself from a particular prototype and you're talking about moment-to-moment." Specifically, the board game simulated Galactic Racer's progression system. items.title: Seamless Landing mod looks set to bring Starfield another step closer to No Man's Sky
items.summary: Or Star Wars Outlaws, if you're nasty.
items.body: There are mods for Seamless Grav Jumps and for Seamless Planet Takeoffs . But when you arrive at a planet in Starfield you still have to choose a landing spot, and then watch a loading screen and an animation. It's another thing that contributes to the feeling your spaceship is more like a house that can teleport. When you're in space, Starfield's planets are basically just textures you can fly right through if you put in the hours to try it, as Alanah Pearce discovered back when the RPG's boundaries were still being explored. It seemed like one gap modders would never be able to paper over, but Frederik Wessberg has apparently managed it. The video of his work-in-progress mod shows a planetary approach, complete with heating effects on the ship during atmospheric entry, a moment of white as he hits a layer of clouds, and then the ship just lands. It seems like the clouds are there to mask a moment of loading, but Wessberg says "the cloud cover is in fact not a fancy loading screen." items.summary: Bumper Bout has a demo on Steam right now.
items.body: One of the great things about videogame conventions is there are always people up for playing a local multiplayer game, just waiting to be handed controls and thrown into a new experience. Which is how, at PAX Australia over the weekend, I found myself playing a game called Bumper Bout. It immediately impressed me with its concept, and then as I played a few rounds of it, with how it executed that concept. Bumper Bout is two-player competitive pinball. If you know Puyo Puyo Tetris it's like that, but if you don't then imagine you're playing pinball on one half of the screen while someone else beside you is doing the same, only with the ability to flick balls across the divide. While you're trying to land a skill shot or just frantically deal with the balls already pinging between your flippers, the neighbor casually lobs another problem over the fence and says, "Deal with this. Good luck!" items.title: Yahtzee is still out there being mean about videogames, and good for him
items.summary: Zero Punctuation was an essential watch back in the day. Its successor Fully Ramblomatic still carries the torch.
items.body: When the HMS Escapist sank everyone worth a damn swam away to form a YouTube channel called Second Wind , where Yahtzee Croshaw's video series Zero Punctuation continued under the name Fully Ramblomatic. It's not exactly the same—the people have glasses now—but it's continuing the essential work of being rude about videogames on the internet. Back in the Before Times, when someone brought a videogame magazine to school we'd all gather round to flick through it, and the only measure of whether it was a good videogame magazine was if the captions on the screenshots were funny. I didn't notice until years later, but that meant we only read the British ones. That particularly British tone is something Yahtzee's videos share. It might come across as flippant to some, but to me it's always read as deep care. Putting in the effort to make a description witty instead of plain means you're working harder to keep your audience engaged, and doing that for videogames suggests you care enough about them to want your audience to actually pay attention. Yahtzee does that. Like Blackadder finding the 100th way to tell Baldrick he's an idiot, he never runs out of ways to complain about videogames.…

items.title: Nier creator Yoko Taro says he's achieved his career dreams, but he continues working because it's 'good for preventing dementia'
items.summary: "With Drakengard, the first game I was given the opportunity to direct, I was actually able to do almost everything the way I wanted."
items.body: They say that art is never finished, only abandoned—but that doesn't seem to be the case for Yoko Taro, creator of Nier and Drakengard, who you might recognize by the round, smiley Emil mask he wears. According to a report from Denfaminicogamer (via IGN ), Taro said at the Tokyo French Institute last month that he's already more or less realized his vision and has considered retiring. "With Drakengard, the first game I was given the opportunity to direct, I was actually able to do almost everything the way I wanted," Taro said. "As a game otaku, I think the dream is to release something you've always wanted to create into the world. Having achieved that dream, I view everything after that as the remainder of my life." As for why he continues to work in gamedev if he's already achieved his dreams, well, he said the money doesn't hurt—and that he has a fear of how his mental health might degrade should he grow idle. "This is good for preventing dementia," he said. It's worth noting that Taro is, to put it in technical terms, a bit of a silly goose, if the mask didn't tip you off. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke. Most videogame RPGs are selling a power fantasy—the idea that you are competent, clever and regardless of the odds will still manage to save the day. Fate has made you a hero, and nothing is going to stop you from achieving your goals. And this holds a lot of appeal. It's sometimes nice to be able to take a holiday from my own incompetence. Over the last few days I've managed to drop my dinner, get trapped on a bus going in the wrong direction, get peed on by a dog, get almost run over by a car and, to top it all off, actually get knocked over by an electric scooter. items.body: Weird Weekend Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager . For most of PC gaming history, there were three states of PC game—your regular old video game, expansions/DLC, and mods. But for a brief period in the 1990s, there was a fourth state, the level pack—collections of levels for the early first-person shooters like Duke Nukem 3D and Quake . These level packs were sold on shelves as boxed products just like their video game counterparts. But they occupied a far more amorphous position between the other three states of PC gaming. items.body: Head to the north of Pendola Pass then go south along the tracks to Almatera Station (Image credit: Embark Studios) Key deets ⚡ Head to the northern tracks in north Pendola Pass. ⚡ Follow them south to Almatera Station. ⚡ Keep your eyes peeled for a Bully and Skulker to ping along the way. The Tracks of the Beast quest in Arc Raiders involves travelling along some train tracks and pinging the new Pendola Pass enemies, the Bully and the Skulker. First off, head to the northern tracks area in the north of the new map—this area encompasses the entire north, so it's easy to complete. After that, head to Almaterra Station to the south, preferably following the train tracks, since there are often Bully and Skulker enemies in this area for the next step. Ping a Bully The Bully is hard to miss due to the loud distinctive sound it makes when it aggros (Image credit: Embark Studios) The challenging part of Tracks of the Beast is you have to do all of the steps in a single round. The Bully is the first enemy you have to ping and it's kind of like a big arc horse-dog robot: There's usually a Bully in Old Town in the southwest of the map. items.title: New Razer Basilisk V4 executes perfect 180 degree turns at the click of a button, all while looking like a Power Ranger's foot
items.summary: It also feels rather fancy, but I can hear the protests about its quick spinning feature from here...
items.body: I'm a sucker for an ergonomically shaped mouse, particularly those with a futuristic design. Which is why I was pleased to have a mess around with the now-announced Razer Basilisk V4 at Gamescom a few months back. It's on the larger side for a gaming rodent, and comes in two flavours: the Basilisk V4 Pro and the Basilisk V4 HyperSpeed . Those familiar with Razer's naming schemes will likely deduce that the HyperSpeed is the more reasonably-priced version, coming in at $110, while the Pro version has a $170 MSRP. The Pro gets a 50K optical sensor with 930 IPS tracking speed and 90G acceleration, alongside Frame Sync to match sensor scanning with the polling rate, while the HyperSpeed uses a 33K, 500 IPS unit. Both also support 8K polling in both wired and wireless modes. Both mice feature four side buttons, one of which can be configured within Razer's Synapse software to enable a " Perfect 180 " feature. As the name suggests, this snaps your aim around a full 180 degrees with a single click, which feels a bit unfair on your opponents. SOCD/Snap Tap all over again? Perhaps. items.title: How to complete To the Skies in Arc Raiders
items.summary: Help Apollo repair the Gondola Prototype.
items.body: Your first step is scanning a crashed Arc Probe and Courier (Image credit: Embark Studios) Key deets ⚡ You'll need Arc Performance Steel, Pop Trigger, Arc Thermo Lining, and Arc Synthetic Resin. ⚡Scan a crashed probe and courier then repair the Gondola Protoype east of the east Spaceport elevator and activate it. Arc Raiders ' To the Skies quest involves finding a few arc parts to repair one of the Prototype Gondolas being used to shuttle raiders to Pendola Pass. First things first, to complete To the Skies you're going to need a variety of arc parts: 1x Arc Performance Steel : Salvaged from big arcs like Bastions, Bombardiers, Leapers, or Baron Husks. 1x Pop Trigger : Salvaged from small exploding Pop robots or couriers. 1x Arc Thermo Lining : Salvaged from Pops, Fireballs, or Baron Husks. 1x Arc Synthetic Resin : Salvaged from intact Arc Probes or Baron Husks. There are a number of other ways to get the materials above, generally by salvaging arc enemies, so if you don't have one of each yet, keep your eyes peeled. items.title: WoW: Forever's list of changes snowballed as Blizzard got more excited, says dev: 'Our original pitch internally was: We'll do 4 new dungeons'
items.summary: "There is a version of WoW Forever that really is that version of Vanilla with just a couple slight class changes."
items.body: Questing through the World of Warcraft: Forever beta, I've been impressed by just how much has been layered on top of the game's Classic world—new quests and new dungeons, designed to slot in seamlessly to the more oldschool playstyle without causing too much friction. It's an impressive magic trick, and one I'm really excited to get stuck into properly come November. Talking to associate production director Clay Stone, Forever initially had far more humble beginnings: "It's been an evolution, and I think that's probably pretty clear from all the classic titles we've done so far in the level of experimentation and breaking away from #NoChanges at the beginning." items.title: Intel to release new CPUs on old socket in early 2027 says Gigabyte - memory crisis making DDR4 desirable again
items.summary: Likely to offer new options with DDR4 support.
items.body: Gigabyte is readying its B760 and H610 motherboards for new LGA1700 processors. Wait, what year is it? "Built on socket LGA1700 and expected to launch in early 2027," Gigabyte says in a post on its website, "the new processors bring fresh performance to an established platform, and Gigabyte users can be ready from day one." These are new LGA1700 chips. We're talking about fresh spins on Raptor Lake and Alder Lake here, which previously made up the 12th/13th/14th Gen, and were last released as a major launch in 2023 . That's a long time ago in CPU land. We've had two consecutive launches since, in Arrow Lake and the Arrow Lake refresh, neither of which dented AMD's stranglehold on the enthusiast market with its X3D chips. So what chance do these old chips have of selling anything? Quite a good one, actually, as these old chips still support DDR4 memory. DDR4 memory is currently a lot cheaper than DDR5 memory. We've seen big price hikes on both, but you can grab a DDR4-3600 32 GB kit for around $210 and a DDR5-6000 32 GB kit for $480 . Ouch. items.title: Peter Molyneux explains the origin story of Black & White's famous creatures: 'It was originally a monster. It wasn't a cute creature'
items.summary: The father of the god game genre reveals all
items.body: Recently, I travelled to Guildford to interview Peter Molyneux, the father of the god game genre, about his final game, Masters of Albion , which just got a major, game-changing update . I've been a long-term fan of Molyneux's games, though, stretching all the way back to Theme Park, so I also took this opportunity to also ask the legendary game dev about, arguably, his most famous god game creation to date, Black & White . And, specifically, I wanted to know where the origin of Black & White's most famous creations came from: the titanic animal creatures that you, as god, nurture in the game and use as an instrument of your will. And, well, the story of how these creatures came to be is interesting. (Image credit: Lionhead Studios) Is Masters of Albion going to get titanic creatures? Molyneux's core strength, to me at least, has always been his uncontainable and seemingly endless creativity. The ability to dream up new games and features has led the legendary dev to create some of PC gaming's most iconic titles, including Populous, Theme Park, Dungeon Keeper, Black & White, and Fable. items.title: Why a 21-year-old coder finally ported the real P.T. to PC: 'That something so influential could eventually become unplayable never sat right with me'
items.summary: Not emulation or a remake, a native PC port of Kojima's horror classic has arrived.
items.body: One of the most beloved horror games (demos?) of all time is finally free from the shackles of the PS4. Hideo Kojima's P.T. has been natively ported to PC by programmer Lorean Xavier, who made the project public this week. Not an emulator nor a remake, the native PC client does not contain any copyrighted materials—it requires a dumped copy of P.T. to function—but instead translates the original code into something that'll run on Windows and Linux. That distinction not only sidesteps potential corporate scrutiny, but also allows Xavier to add modern graphical features and mod support to the PC version. It's an impressive effort that, according to the creator, has been in the works since 2024. "I wanted to make the version of P.T. that my younger self always wished existed," Xavier, 21, told PC Gamer over email. "My attachment to the game goes all the way back to my childhood. I remember watching videos of it on my phone, wishing I could experience it myself. I didn't have a PS4, so playing the original was never really an option for me.
